changelog:
Initial release – automates invoice extraction from emails and local files for finance teams.

- Automatically retrieves invoice attachments via IMAP/OAuth email or local folders.
- Batch-extracts key invoice fields (invoice number, amount, currency, etc.) using ADP.
- Exports results to Excel files or business systems, eliminating manual data entry.
- Guided, configurable workflow adapts to various email and business platforms.
- Supports batch processing, concurrency, and flexible field mapping.
